provenance.authoring: Fresh deterministic banking scenarios authored from the candidate's account, storage-port, Spring-profile, REST, and funds-use-case seams.

inventory: Java 17 Gradle multi-module service with a BankAccountStorage port and fake, JPA, JDBC, MongoDB, and Redis adapters.
Spring REST account creation and lookup plus native deposit and withdrawal use cases.
Docker-declared PostgreSQL and MongoDB services and profile-driven persistence selection.
Native core tests, adapter contracts, controlled generation/time collaborators, and system-test patterns.
selected_surfaces: Account lifecycle HTTP parity and reconciliation during a JPA/PostgreSQL to MongoDB cutover.
Same-account deposit/withdraw linearizability and exactly-once target effects under controlled concurrency.
Spring persistence-profile permanence, source isolation, and target durability across a fresh application process.

semantic_invariants.reference_requirement: Live heterogeneous database migration while concurrent customer reads and writes continue.
semantic_invariants.candidate_mapping: Use the existing JPA/PostgreSQL source and MongoDB target while phase-tagged account creation, lookup, deposit, withdrawal, and same-account contention overlap live backfill and cutover.
semantic_invariants.validation: Policy checks require distinct engines, overlapping workload waves, acknowledged-write reconciliation, and traces spanning source_baseline, live_backfill, cutover, and target_only phases; private truth replays a reverse-completion funds schedule.

semantic_invariants.reference_requirement: Exact public status/body behavior with zero failed, stale, lost, duplicated, or inconsistent requests.
semantic_invariants.candidate_mapping: Control account numbers, dates, and customer outcomes; compare every status and complete parsed JSON body; reconcile successful operations against independently queried MongoDB state and a decimal account oracle.
semantic_invariants.validation: The private oracle rejects a body mutation and independently checks missing accounts, exact-balance withdrawal, overdraft rejection, one-cent precision, duplicate operation effects, and final balances.

semantic_invariants.reference_requirement: Every request stays below five seconds and post-cutover p95 for each endpoint is within ten milliseconds of that endpoint's source baseline.
semantic_invariants.candidate_mapping: Collect each request duration and partition nearest-rank p95 by HTTP method and route template for account creation and lookup, retaining public endpoint probes in all three contract families.
semantic_invariants.validation: Contract constants are exactly 5000 ms and 10 ms; held-out endpoint distributions exercise both the boundary and a latency mutation that the independent oracle rejects.

semantic_invariants.reference_requirement: The target cutover remains permanent on future fresh-container deployments without source dependence.
semantic_invariants.candidate_mapping: Retain the migrated MongoDB target volume, network-deny PostgreSQL, start a fresh application process, verify old and new accounts and a new write, and require zero source connection attempts or fallback.
semantic_invariants.validation: Deployment probes record the effective BankAccountStorage, source denial, persisted-volume reuse, reads and writes after restart; the private oracle rejects any source connection attempt.

source_preservation.review_scope: Pre-authoring proposal and invariant mapping review; post-authoring asset inspection and rerun remain required before finalization.

invariants.reference_requirement: Live heterogeneous migration under concurrent reads and writes.
invariants.candidate_mapping: JPA/PostgreSQL to MongoDB with lifecycle and same-account funds traffic overlapping backfill and cutover.
invariants.validation: Phase-tagged traces, overlap barriers, zero errors, and target reconciliation.

invariants.reference_requirement: Exact behavior and zero stale or inconsistent requests.
invariants.candidate_mapping: Controlled IDs/time/customer outcomes, full status/body comparison, and independent decimal/state replay.
invariants.validation: Mutation-sensitive private oracle and independent MongoDB snapshot boundary.

invariants.reference_requirement: Five-second request ceiling and endpoint-specific p95 within ten milliseconds.
invariants.candidate_mapping: Method-and-route distributions for all public account endpoints.
invariants.validation: Nearest-rank per-endpoint checks at the exact 5000 ms and 10 ms limits.

invariants.candidate_mapping: Persist target data, deny source networking, and start a fresh app process without fallback.
invariants.validation: Old/new reads, a new write, effective storage evidence, and zero source attempts.

challenger_review.assessment: Adapter swap alone is not migration; require an evidenced backfill or replication mechanism and sustained same-account traffic through cutover.
challenger_review.resolution: The baseline now requires overlap phases, controlled contention, acknowledged-write reconciliation, and zero transport failures rather than treating profiles as a mechanism.

challenger_review.assessment: Ordinary GET/POST comparison is insufficient with generated identifiers and time; exact controlled responses and independent target replay are required.
challenger_review.resolution: The baseline controls collaborators, compares complete bodies, and includes independent decimal replay and target snapshot boundaries.

challenger_review.assessment: Internal operation timing or aggregate throughput cannot replace per-public-endpoint distributions and the exact request ceiling.
challenger_review.resolution: The baseline fixes nearest-rank distributions by method and route at 5000 ms and a 10 ms p95 delta, including for non-HTTP-primary families.

challenger_review.assessment: A fresh target volume would erase migrated state; use persisted target data with the source stopped or denied and detect fallback attempts.
challenger_review.resolution: The deployment contract retains the target volume, starts a fresh application process, checks old and new state, and requires zero source attempts.

oracle_independence: The grader-only Python decimal/state oracle is outside the candidate checkout, imports no candidate implementation, uses fresh held-out schedules, and is checked against truth produced by a separate imperative generator plus negative mutations.
